notes: Positive: explicit requests for ADRs, decision records, or RFC-style decision documentation. Negative: open-ended architecture exploration (architect agent), PRDs, tech-specs, code implementation. Edge: ambiguous wording where 'decision document' could be misread as a long design doc.

cases.query: Write an ADR for our decision to use Postgres for transactional state
Document this architecture decision: we are dropping the Kafka cluster in favor of NATS JetStream
Necesito un registro de decisión para el cambio de monolito a modular monolith
Create a decision record for using OAuth 2.1 client credentials for our partner API
Draft the ADR superseding ADR-0014 — we are moving from REST to gRPC for internal service-to-service
Write an RFC for the architecture change to introduce a feature-flag service
Add an ADR to docs/adr/ documenting why we chose Argon2id over bcrypt for password hashing
Capture the decision to deprecate the v1 API and move all clients to v2 by Q4 — needs an ADR
Design the architecture for the new fraud-detection service
Write a PRD for the new checkout flow
Implement the Postgres connection pool in our service
Write a tech-spec for the payment service rewrite

cases.notes: Exploration, not a decision yet. An RFC fits; ADR comes after the decision.
